research_readiness.reason: Below 30 rows, percentage-based corruption scenarios remain coarse and should be treated as a demonstration. Publication claims should use larger independently sourced datasets.

evaluation.method: Controlled corruptions are applied directly to the uploaded reference without pre-cleaning by SelfHealDS. Each case stores its original value, corrupted value, issue label and expected repair where applicable. Natural pre-existing findings are subtracted from the prediction set so they do not become benchmark false positives. The corruption mix includes obvious rule violations and plausible-but-wrong values to test the abstention boundary.

metric_definitions.precision: TP/(TP+FP), conditional on the system making a positive detection.
metric_definitions.recall: TP/(TP+FN), proportion of injected labelled corruptions detected with the matching issue label.
metric_definitions.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
metric_definitions.repair_accuracy: Correct repaired target divided by automatic repair attempts; conditional on automation. Non-inferable cases are never counted as correct.
metric_definitions.safe_repair_coverage: Correct automatic repairs divided by injected cases with an explicitly known safe target. This measures how much of the safely repairable benchmark was actually repaired correctly.
metric_definitions.clean_false_positive_rate: False positives divided by the cells that were NOT deliberately corrupted (total reference cells minus injected cases). Measures how often the detector raises a finding on data it had no reason to flag.
metric_definitions.unsafe_repair_rate: Unsafe/incorrect automatic repairs divided by automatic repair attempts; N/A when no automatic repair was attempted.

baseline.baseline_definition: Missing-value and exact-duplicate detection only. This is a transparent internal baseline, not a reproduction of a commercial system. A metric is N/A when the baseline makes no positive predictions rather than being awarded perfect precision.

experimental_protocol.reason_for_rates: Five, ten, twenty and thirty percent scenarios represent increasing controlled corruption severity; the values are experimental design levels, not claims of real-world prevalence.
experimental_protocol.reason_for_trials: Five fixed seeds provide repeated deterministic row selections so reported means and sample standard deviations expose run-to-run variation. They are not a population confidence interval.
experimental_protocol.baseline: Minimal missing-value and exact-duplicate detector. It is a transparent internal baseline, not a claim to reproduce a commercial product.
experimental_protocol.ground_truth: Each injected case stores row, column, issue type, original value, corrupted value and expected repair when an exact target exists.
experimental_protocol.small_dataset_reason: Datasets below 30 rows can make percentage-based corruption levels too coarse for publication-grade benchmarking; use larger independently curated datasets for final paper results.

policy_rationale.age_upper_bound: A conservative domain boundary for ordinary human-age fields. It is a validation policy, not a claim about every possible age-related dataset.
policy_rationale.phone_range: A broad generic international identifier range. Because country-specific numbering plans differ, this is a structural plausibility check rather than proof that a number is assigned.
policy_rationale.missing_rate: Automatic imputation is limited to at most one-fifth missingness. Above this level, the observed sample may be too incomplete for a simple single-value fallback to be defensible without domain context.
policy_rationale.missing_min_observed: At least five observed values are required before a single-value fallback is used. This is a conservative minimum for a small-sample engineering rule, not a statistical guarantee.
policy_rationale.iqr_multiplier: The conventional 1.5×IQR exploratory fence is used to flag unusual values. It identifies potential outliers; it does not establish that a value is erroneous.
policy_rationale.quality_weights: The quality score is an internal comparison indicator. Errors receive full penalty, warnings 0.35 and informational findings 0.10 to preserve severity ordering. These weights are not learned and are not an industry standard.

metric_validity: All metrics are snapshots valid only for this dataset fingerprint, ruleset version, evaluation protocol, seeds and execution timestamp.
